brand.name: RxFlow
brand.theme: Dual-mode (Dark for Auth, Light for Workspace)

body.style: High legibility, distinct character recognition (critical for pharmacy)

mono.style: Used for timestamps, IDs, and precise data

spacing_and_layout.auth: Centered glassmorphism container. Max-width 400px. High internal padding (3rem). Negative space isolates the login.
spacing_and_layout.workspace: Control Room Grid (Dense). 250px Sidebar + Main Content. Cards use p-6 for breathing room, but inner data lists use tight gap-2. Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 for stats.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum. Clinical UI shouldn't be overly bubbly.

iconography.rules: DE-EMOJI completely. Use clean line icons. 16px for inline, 20px for controls.
iconography.implementation: Auth uses lucide-react. Workspace uses CDN script <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script> and lucide.createIcons().

button.primary: Solid accent bg, white text, rounded-md, hover:brightness-110, transition-all duration-200. No heavy shadow.
button.secondary: Transparent bg, 1px solid border, text-primary, hover:bg-slate-50 (light) or hover:bg-slate-800 (dark).

input.style: Sharp. 1px solid border, rounded-md, px-3 py-2. Focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent.

badge.style: Pill shape (rounded-full), px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs, font-semibold, uppercase tracking-wide.

workflow_stepper.style: Horizontal track. Completed: solid accent. Active: ringed. Pending: grayed out. Labels below nodes.

card.workspace: Solid white, flat, 1px border-slate-200. Hover: slight shadow-sm.

states.skeleton: Pulse animation on gray block elements (bg-slate-200).
states.empty: Centered content, muted text, 24px Lucide icon, optional action button.
states.error: Red border, pale red background, error icon, descriptive text.

image_urls.description: Modern laboratory blur dark background. Use as the full-screen background for the Auth portal with a heavy dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/70) so the glass card pops.

page_specific_instructions.auth_portal: Splash screen with fading logo. Login/Signup/Reset mapped to glass cards. Use pure CSS or CSS modules mapping to the dark color tokens. React + Vite context.
page_specific_instructions.workspace_dashboard: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS in index.html. Header (sticky, search, user). Stats strip (5 metrics). Intake list (severity sorted, chips). Intake form. Patient search. Modal for counseling. Toast for pickup.
page_specific_instructions.testing_requirements: Add data-testid to EVERY button, input, badge, and interactive element. Format: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

technical_constraints: Workspace MUST remain a single HTML file with inline/block CSS and JS. NO React, NO build step for workspace. Auth portal uses React + Vite + CSS (no Tailwind).
